    What this is

    See work happening across the planet. Then watch the satellite record.

    1. 1Browse coasts, forests, reefs, and energy sites worldwide.
    2. 2Open a site to scrub its Sentinel-2 timeline.
    3. 3See how close each milestone is to the stated goal.
    4. 4Run an automatic check. Optionally sign the readout locally.

    Index is a preview-image green / water / brightness score from public Sentinel-2 L2A scenes — not a full NDVI product. Weather, SST, and irradiance are context, not proof. The SHA is local; nothing is written to Solana.
